title: frametrail:attributes of type "hotspot"
description: Hotspot overlay: a clickable shape (circle, rectangle, rounded rectangle) that marks something in the picture and can open a URL or jump to a time or another hypervideo, or a drawn mark (arrow, underline, freeform outline) that points something out. Overlay only. A plain hotspot made in the editor pauses the video when it appears (frametrail:pause on the item); the drawn marks do not. A freeform hotspot takes clicks only inside its outline (its action, its onClick code): the rest of its box lets them through to what lies beneath, another overlay or the video. This schema describes the frametrail:attributes of items whose type is "hotspot". On overlays, opacity, hoverStyle, zIndex and animation apply as on every overlay type. Unknown keys are allowed; writers keep them.

color.description: CSS colour of the outline (of the line for arrow and underline), and of the pulse.

borderWidth.description: Outline or line width in pixels. 0 means no outline.

borderRadius.description: rounded only: corner radius in pixels.

backgroundColor.description: CSS fill colour of the closed shapes (not drawn for arrow and underline). Empty means no fill. Where pulse is missing, a fill hides the pulse ring.

pulse.description: Closed shapes: show the pulse ring, an expanding ring in the outline colour. Missing means on unless the hotspot has a fill (hotspots made before the switch). Arrow and underline never pulse.

text.description: Label inside the hotspot, plain text. Not drawn for arrow and underline.

direction.description: arrow only: where the arrow points.

curve.description: arrow only: straight, curved (one bend) or swoop (S-like).

points.description: freeform only: the outline as points in 0–100 box coordinates. Smooth points let the outline curve through them, the others are corners. An outline that changes over time has points on the keyframes of the overlay's box motion as well (frametrail:keyframes); this is then the outline of the first keyframe, which a consumer shows that does not know them.

path.description: freeform only: the outline as an SVG path in 0–100 box coordinates. Derived from points and written for other consumers; a shape that has only a path (older data) is drawn from it and converted to points on its first edit.

linkUrl.description: Legacy. URL opened on click, from before the action model. Treated as action "openUrl" when action is empty.
